1078998.title: An invoice without a due date is aged from its customer's credit term

results.comment:
Blocked at step 4: an invoice with no due date cannot be made - the app always stores one from the customer's credit term.

Tested on QA site sv11315, build v26.45.3-34788b2, on 12 November 2026.

  • Retest 12 Nov 2026 on build v26.45.3-34788b2: a Net 30 customer (ZZR No Due Date Q13) and an invoice dated 40 days ago (S11315-17912): the app stored the due date Nov 1, 2026 at once.
  • No new ticket: the PRD says how the report ages an invoice that has no due date; it does not ask that such invoices can be made.

What needs to be done: nothing to fix; this test can only run where an invoice without a due date already exists.

results.comment:
Blocked at step 4: a $100.00 bill cannot be paid $110.00 - the app refuses to overpay a vendor bill.

Tested on QA site sv11315, build v26.45.3-34788b2, on 12 November 2026.

  • Retest 12 Nov 2026 on build v26.45.3-34788b2: vendor "ZZRV Overpaid Q13b" with a $100.00 bill; paying $110.00 is refused with "Vendor transaction cannot be overpaid." On the vendor's Unpaid Invoices tab, typing 110.00 shows "Payment cannot be higher than 100" and Make Payment stays disabled.
  • Overpaying a customer invoice is refused on production the same way (12 Nov).
  • No new ticket: the PRD describes how the report lists an overpaid bill; it does not ask that one can be made.

What needs to be done: nothing to fix; this test can only run where an overpaid bill already exists.

1095432.title: Planned change: A/R Summary Totals add up the rows, overpaid left out

results.comment:
Blocked at step 3: an invoice paid more than its amount cannot be made - the app refuses the overpayment.

Tested on QA site sv11315, build v26.45.3-34788b2, on 12 November 2026.

  • Retest 12 Nov 2026 on build v26.45.3-34788b2: a new $100.00 invoice (S11315-17913, customer ZZX Overpaid Q13); the app's payment of $120.00 is refused with "Transaction cannot be overpaid." and the invoice stays $100.00 open. On screen (its work order's Finance page, New Payment), typing 120.00 shows "Payment cannot be higher than 100" and Make Payment stays disabled.
  • Production today (before the release): a payment of $1,102.93 on its $1,082.93 invoice S2-1760 is refused with "Transaction cannot be overpaid." - the same as the new build.
  • No new ticket: refusing an overpayment is how payments already work on production; the PRD only describes how the report treats overpaid invoices that already exist, it does not ask that new ones can be made.

What needs to be done: nothing to fix; this test can only run on an organization that already holds an overpaid invoice (the PRD says production has 16 such invoices, made in the past).
results.case_title: Planned change: A/R Summary Totals add up the rows, overpaid left out

results.comment:
Blocked at step 3: customer X (a $100.00 invoice paid $120.00) cannot be made - the app refuses to overpay an invoice.

Tested on QA site sv11315, build v26.45.2-6a8b89c, on 11 November 2026.

  • Step 3 cannot be set up: paying a $100.00 invoice $120.00 is refused through the app's payment request, and both payment screens stop at "Payment cannot be higher than 100" (tried 11 Nov for C715462, same result).
  • Steps 4-6 were run anyway on A/R Aging Summary as of 11/11/2026 (all customers, all locations): the 147 customer rows' Total column adds up to $521,344.25, and the Totals row reads $521,344.25 - the two figures are equal.
  • So the part of the planned change that can be checked works: the Totals row adds up exactly the customer rows above it.

What needs to be done: the QA lead decides whether this test is kept (and how an overpaid invoice can be made), reworded to the totals check alone, or retired - the app no longer lets an invoice be overpaid.
